title: Gluten Free Food & Brew Tours
includes: Tips are not included; they are not required, but much appreciated! Tips for spots are included
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Denver’s best & only gluten free & brew tour with a local foodie, world traveler, & celiac! I was a gluten free travel blogger for years & built & sold the first dedicated gluten free app!

I lived abroad for 5 years, so I bring my world traveling experience, being gluten free in numerous countries, & my passion for food, bringing people together, & travel!

Denver is one of the best places to be gluten free & I’m going to show you all the gems that you will love! I promise those who eat gluten will love this tour too!

Ask is simple: come hungry, open-minded, & with comfortable shoes. You’ll leave with new friends, tasty new food & drinks in your belly.

You’ll not only have an insider’s knowledge to the city but you’ll also leave with a huge list of places to check out!

Must be 21 for this tour as we have 2 drink spots & 2 food spots.
